description: This file handles dispatching Slack messages, including streaming, reactions, threading, and reply management within a Slack integration module.

classes.name: SlackStreamSession
classes.description: Type representing an active Slack streaming session.

methods.name: sleep
methods.description: Asynchronous delay function that resolves after specified milliseconds.

methods.name: toSlackEmojiName
methods.description: Converts a Unicode emoji to its Slack shortcode name, or returns the input if not found.

methods.name: hasMedia
methods.description: Checks if the reply payload contains media content.

methods.name: isSlackStreamingEnabled
methods.description: Determines if Slack streaming is enabled based on mode and native streaming flag.

methods.name: shouldEnableSlackPreviewStreaming
methods.description: Decides if Slack preview streaming should be enabled based on mode, DM status, and thread presence.

methods.name: shouldInitializeSlackDraftStream
methods.description: Checks if a Slack draft stream should be initialized based on preview streaming and streaming usage.

methods.name: resolveSlackStreamingThreadHint
methods.description: Resolves the thread timestamp hint for Slack streaming based on reply mode and message context.

methods.name: shouldUseStreaming
methods.description: Determines whether to use streaming based on enabled status and thread availability.

methods.name: dispatchPreparedSlackMessage
methods.description: Main function to dispatch a prepared Slack message, handling streaming, reactions, threading, and reply lifecycle.
